pr_title: Fill a looped curve with the selected background color
pr_body:
Fixes  #1262

When drawing multi-point lines, if the last point is close to the first point, we determine that the shape could be filled.
Hit testing is updated to detect cursor inside the shape in a filled path. 

I have also updated to a newer version of roughjs that I created with better curve filling algorithm. There were no other changes in this roughjs release.

Does it feel odd that you cannot fill a shape that is not closed?

![Apr-08-2020 00-16-48](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/833927/78756308-6ef20500-792f-11ea-9f52-31aa5a9eff59.gif)

issue_context.title: Filling closed multi-point lines
issue_context.body:
Not sure if this is a common use case, but when creating a sketch today, I wished there were a way to fill a closed path - draw a multipoint line but the last point of the line closes the loop. 

Simple closed loops could be detected by measuring the distance between first and last point, and if it's within an error of margin. 

There are cases where paths could have multiple loops or n points in the middle create a loop.
comments: How would you implement hitbox testing for an arbitrary shape?

For clicking within the shape?
Good point. This can get complicated. Quick thought, perhaps reduce the shape into a polygon and then use something like https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Point_in_polygon. 
I suspect https://github.com/maxnachlinger/point-in-svg-path does something similar.
But yeah, don't want too much computation if it's something that would happen often
Also, to make sure I understand --- this request is also about filling in background, right? In which case we wouldn't be able to use a low-resolution polygon heuristic...
I’ve been wanting that as well! Would love to see it happen. It also fits nicely without having to add anymore UI.
Also those..!

The [even-odd rules](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Even%E2%80%93odd_rule) allows filling of shapes like these. 
Roughjs supports filling of arbitrary SVG paths but it does that using pattern fills which are not as performant. 

I will create a fork to play with this, and hopefully get this feature when I have some time this week. Perhaps enhance roughjs as well if I get it right.

Implemented a polygon approximation for curves in rough (unreleased). Luckily I had some code lying around that I could reuse. 
![curve-fitting-min](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/833927/78606478-41fc0000-7812-11ea-8d74-82913e504329.jpg)

Excalidraw could call that same function in roughjs geometry module to get the polygon for hit testing. 

Will try that tomorrow perhaps.
I was just looking for this feature. Great to see that it is going to be available soon.
